name: Doer
overview: Scripture emphasizes that true discipleship involves more than hearing or professing faith; it requires actively doing the will of God. Jesus teaches that entrance into the kingdom of heaven and true kinship with Him are granted to those who do God's will (Matthew 7:21; 12:50). The apostle Paul reinforces this by stating that justification comes not to hearers alone but to doers of the law (Romans 2:13), highlighting the inward work of God's law written on the heart, which guides conscience and action even apart from the written law (Romans 2:14-15). Thus, being a doer of the Word is essential to living out genuine faith.
